nodes.title: Test Realtime ssl not available and invalid_token
nodes.body: link:https://github.com/supabase/realtime/issues/1509 **Test failed with docker-compose.yml** ### 1. use realtime.js version 2.15.2(latest) realtime logs: ```text 08:25:46.374 project=kongtest [info] Billing metrics: [:realtime, :rate_counter, :channel, :joins] 08:25:47.498 project=kongtest external_id=kongtest [error] UnknownErrorOnChannel: :invalid_token ``` ### 2. use realtime.js version 2.11.2 realtime logs: ```text 08:17:53.779 project=kongtest external_id=kongtest application_name=realtime_connect [error] Postgrex.Protocol (#PID<0.3688.0>) failed to connect: ** (Postgrex.Error) ssl not available 08:17:53.779 project=kongtest external_id=kongtest application_name=realtime_connect [error] :gen_statem #PID<0.3688.0> terminating ** (Postgrex.Error) ssl not available (db_connection 2.8.0) lib/db_connection/connection.ex:104: DBConnection.Connection.handle_event/4 (stdlib 6.1.2) gen_statem.erl:3737: :gen_statem.loop_state_callback/11 (stdlib 6.1.2) proc_lib.erl:329: :proc_lib.init_p_do_apply/3 Queue: [internal: {:connect, :init}] Postponed: [] 08:17:53.781 project=kongtest external_id=kongtest error_code=UnableToConnectToTenantDatabase [error] UnableToConnectToTenantDatabase: :killed 08:17:53.781 project=kongtest external_id=kongtest sub= iss= exp=1758845744 [error] UnableToConnectToProject: Realtime was unable to connect to the project database ``` db logs: ```text 192.168.97.1 2025-08-27 08:53:54.973 UTC [278] [unknown]@[unknown] LOG: invalid length of startup packet 192.168.97.1 2025-08-27 09:34:57.636 UTC [320] [unknown]@[unknown] LOG: invalid length of startup packet ``` ## To Reproduce ### 1. setup realtime ```git git clone https://github.com/supabase/realtime.git git checkout releases/v2.43.1 ``` ```shell docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d ``` ### 2. create tenant ```python #!/usr/bin/env python # -*- coding: utf-8 -* import datetime import json import jwt import requests http_url = "http://kongtest.localhost:4000/api/tenants" secret_key = "******" # same as realtime document def jwt_token(): algorithm = "HS256" payload = { "iss": "", "iat": int((datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(days=-1)).timestamp()), "exp": int((datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(days=30)).timestamp()), "aud": "", "sub": "", "role": "kongtest" } encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(payload, secret_key, algorithm=algorithm) print(encoded_jwt) return encoded_jwt def create_tenant(tenant_id): payload = { "tenant": { "name": tenant_id, "external_id": tenant_id, "jwt_secret": secret_key, "extensions": [ { "type": "postgres_cdc_rls", "settings": { "db_name": "postgres", "db_host": "host.docker.internal", "db_user": "postgres", "db_password": "postgres", "db_port": "5432", "region": "us-west-1", "poll_interval_ms": 100, "poll_max_record_bytes": 1048576 } } ] } } header = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer {}".format(jwt_token()) } try: r = requests.post(url=http_url, headers=header, data=json.dumps(payload)) print(r.text) except Exception as e: print(e) def list_tenants(): header = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer {}".format(jwt_token()) } try: r = requests.get(url=http_url, headers=header) print(r.text) except Exception as e: print(e) def main(): create_tenant('kongtest') list_tenants() if __name__ == '__main__': main() ``` ### 3. start postgres changes listener js code: ```js import { RealtimeClient } from "@supabase/realtime-js"; const http_url = "ws://kongtest.localhost:4000/socket"; const api_key = "******"; // use create tenant jwt token const client = new RealtimeClient(http_url, { params: { apikey: api_key } }); const channel = client.channel('db-changes') channel.on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public' }, (payload) => { console.log('All changes in public schema: ', payload) }) channel.on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'todos' }, (payload) => { console.log('All inserts in todos table: ', payload) }) channel.subscribe(async (status) => { if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') { console.log('Ready to receive database changes!') } }) ``` package.json: ```json { "type": "module", "name": "untitled1", "version": "1.0.0", "main": "index.js", "scripts": { "test": "echo \"Error: no test specified\" && exit 1" }, "keywords": [], "author": "", "license": "ISC", "description": "", "dependencies": { "@supabase/realtime-js": "2.15.2" // Similarly, version 2.11.2 also test failed } } ``` ## Expected behavior client print the postgres changes as json format, but there nothing output ## Screenshots ### realtime-js@2.15.2 error: ### realtime-js@2.11.2 error: ## System information - OS: macOS - Version of realtime-js: 2.15.2; 2.11.2 - Version of Node.js: v24.2.0 - Docker Platform: OrbStack
